params.body:
## Why

Ilse, 18 September 2026: the daily mail with the new bidding vehicles no longer arrives, while Frederik did get a mail after creating the 3008 as a bidding vehicle. Was that sent to all merchants and dealers, or only to his own merchants?

## What was wrong

- The daily mail is `stocklist:dailyexport`. Together with `stocklist:daily` (08:00) and `dealer:has-open-worklist-items` (09:00) it was a separate cron line in Delta's old crontab (07:45). Those three lines were not recreated on Forge after the cutover of 2026-09-15; only `schedule:run` exists there (added 2026-09-18). Nobody received the daily mail since 16 September.
- The three places that mark a bidding as mailed wrote `send_mail`; the column on `export_vehicles` is `mail_send`, so Eloquent dropped the key silently (finding X-18).

## What changed

- `routes/console.php`: the three commands on the Laravel scheduler at 07:45, 08:00 and 09:00, `timezone('Europe/Brussels')` (the application timezone and what Delta's crontab assumed), `withoutOverlapping`. Each refuses outside production via `Outbound::allowed()` (the preview and the demo run this same file on a copy of the production database); `dealer:has-open-worklist-items` gets that same lock, which it did not have. `Outbound::seal()` sends every mail of a non-production environment to the log anyway.
- `send_mail` -> `mail_send` in `OwnStockController::sendMailsForExport`, `OwnStockService::finalizeCreate`, `VehicleObserver::updated`. `ExportDailyMail` declares its two properties (they were dynamic).
- `CUTOVER.md`, section Cron-jobs: the three lines live in the scheduler; only `schedule:run` remains on Forge. If loose lines for these three are ever added on Forge, every mail goes out twice: remove them.

## Answer to Ilse's question (from the code, `MailHelper::sendMails`)

The mail on creation, with the default "iedereen mag bieden": **all dealers on the platform with the bidding module** (except the owner), **only the owner's own merchants** (never another dealer's merchants), and the owner himself as a copy; each recipient filtered on his own preferences (brand, fuel, maximum mileage); and **not** to anyone who chose "één mail per dag": those wait for the daily mail. "Enkel Stocklist community" = only the dealers, "enkel eigen handelaars" = only the own merchants. So Frederik's mail after the 3008 was the copy for the selling dealer; the same mail went to every other dealer with the module (on preferences) and to his own merchants, unless they are on one-mail-per-day.

The daily mail (`DailyExports::doDailyExports`): per dealer with the module and "één mail per dag", and per merchant with "één mail per dag", the running biddings whose vehicle was created or changed since yesterday (`vehicles.updated_at`, not `created_at`), from every dealer on the platform, matching his preferences, not bid on or dismissed by him, at most fifteen. Whether a vehicle was mailed before plays no role. Note for Ilse (new finding `dagmail-handelaren-hele-platform`): for a merchant the daily mail is not limited to his own dealer's biddings and does not check the bidding type per vehicle, unlike the creation mail. Behaviour left as it was; question recorded.

## Docs and rules

- Decision `docs/bedrijfsregels/bronnen/beslissingen/2026-09-18-dagelijkse-biedingsmail.md` (Ilse's question and the code facts as quotes).
- R B1-1.11 now says precisely who receives the creation mail, sourced (`klant:beslissingen#dagelijkse-biedingsmail`, `code:MailHelper::sendMails`, ...), no longer disputed. New R B1-2.15: the schedule of the three daily jobs. `php bin/rules-sources`: "Geen problemen".
- X-18 (`2026-09-11-de-wagen-staat-klaar-en-de-mail.md`) resolved.

## Tests

- `ScheduleTest`: the three commands at `45 7 * * *`, `0 8 * * *`, `0 9 * * *`, Europe/Brussels, withoutOverlapping (`@rule B1-2.15`).
- `BiddingMailsTest` (Mail::fake, no real mail): creation mail recipients (other bidding dealer yes, own merchant yes, owner copy yes; foreign merchant, dealer without module and one-mail-per-day dealer no); the row is marked `mail_send = 1`; no file writes `send_mail` any more; `stocklist:dailyexport` mails the one-mail-per-day dealer the bidding of yesterday and not the one of two days ago, and not the direct dealer; the three jobs print "Overgeslagen" outside production and send nothing. Mutation-checked: the old spelling fails two tests.
- Run: ScheduleTest, BiddingMailsTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, RulesSourcesTest, PreviewEnvironmentTest, DocsPagesTest, CompiledViewsTest, HandlerWiringTest, AlpineExpressionTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, VehicleFormSaveTest, OutboundTest, BiddingTypeChoiceTest, BiddingTest: all green.

No hot shared files touched.
params.title: Schedule the daily bidding mail again and mark biddings as mailed
